definitions.explanation: A long-term plan or approach to achieve a goal, especially in business or military contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{戦略|せんりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
⟦{戦略的|せんりゃくてき}→戦略的：25933_senryakuteki⟧な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧{戦略|せんりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。

notes:
{戦略|せんりゃく} refers to long-term planning to achieve major goals. Originally military, now widely used in business.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{戦|せん}→戦：noentry⟧ (war/battle) + ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (plan/scheme)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦略|せんりゃく} (strategy): long-term, big picture
- ⟦{戦術|せんじゅつ}→戦術：12748_senjutsu⟧ (tactics): short-term, specific methods

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦略|せんりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to formulate a strategy
- {戦略|せんりゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to devise a strategy
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{戦略|せんりゃく}: sales strategy
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧{戦略|せんりゃく}: business strategy
